name: Precision Plastics Packaging Co.
old_description: Precision Plastics Packaging Co. (PPPC) is a leading full-service manufacturer of premium, private label products. It all started in 1963 with a simple printing unit. Today, we’re a leading company whose stability, innovation and customization services attract Fortune 500 firms and Small Independent businesses alike. Our company’s location is a 120,000 square feet facility in Anaheim, California.  We employ about 150 people – many who have been with Precision Plastics Packaging Co. for more than two decades. Our technologies are intricate, but our approach to serving you is simple. We manufacture and decorate more than a million superior quality plastic containers per day. The company produces plastic bottles of various sizes and shapes through our sophisticated injection stretch blow molding and extrusion stretch blow molding machines. The firm accomplishes the printing process using an advanced hi-tech silk screen printing machine comprising of multiple print heads with a capacity of approx. a million bottles per day. Precision Plastics Packaging Co. uses “Make to Order” and “Make to Stock” production strategy to match production and inventory with consumer demand forecasts. We are proud of our excellent reputation and the standards of our company’s craftsmanship, commitment, quality, technological innovation, and inventiveness.  These have been our guiding principles for more than five decades, and that’s the primary reason of our firm’s increasing market share and customer base.
about:
Precision Plastics Packaging Co. (PPPC) was founded in 1963 in Anaheim, California, starting with a simple printing unit. The privately held company operates a 120,000-square-foot facility in Anaheim and employs approximately 150 people, many of whom have been with the company for over two decades.

PPPC manufactures and decorates plastic bottles using injection stretch blow molding, extrusion stretch blow molding, and silk screen printing with multi-head machines. The facility also runs hot-stamping operations. The company produces more than one million containers per day and employs both make-to-order and make-to-stock strategies to align production with demand forecasts.

The company serves cosmeceutical markets with FDA-approved bottles and acts as a certified vendor for that sector. Its customer base ranges from Fortune 500 corporations to small independent businesses, though specific client names are not disclosed.

PPPC attributes its growth to guiding principles of craftsmanship, commitment, quality, technological innovation, and inventiveness maintained over five decades. The firm emphasizes stability, innovation, and customization services as key differentiators that attract and retain customers.
